title: KFC Canada: log the named chicken piece
description: The Canadian table gives separate Original Recipe values for keel, rib, drumstick, wing and thigh. A generic entry called one piece of KFC chicken cannot describe all five. Start with the piece actually eaten, then add separately listed sides and drinks.

title: KFC UK: Fillet Burger or Original Ranch Rice Bowl
description: The September 2026 UK&I table gives the Fillet Burger and Original Ranch Rice Bowl the same 28.8 g protein. The rest of their nutrition differs, so a bowl name alone does not establish a lower-calorie choice.

title: KFC Ireland: the Fillet Roll has its own serving
description: The official September 2026 shared UK&I sheet marks both Fillet Rolls with #, meaning Ireland-only. Their local entries are preserved for Ireland and excluded from Great Britain coverage.

title: GYG Australia: Mini Bowl versus Mini Burrito
description: The March 9, 2026 Australian guide publishes separate mild grilled chicken Mini Bowl and Mini Burrito recipes. Their names share a filling, but each row is a complete named build with its own source serving.

title: Subway New Zealand: regular and large teriyaki salads
description: The May 2026 New Zealand guide gives separate recipes for regular and large salads. The large Sweet Onion Chicken Teriyaki salad is a published 500 g portion, while the regular is 300 g. A large entry is not created by doubling the regular numbers.

title: MOS Japan: MOS Burger and Teriyaki Chicken Burger
description: MOS Japan’s October 14, 2026 table reports each named item with a source weight. The MOS Burger is 211.2 g; the Teriyaki Chicken Burger is 148.9 g. The comparison is between those actual local recipes and portions.

title: Subway Mexico: Gran Pastor versus Gringo Pastor
description: The August 2026 Mexican source names Gran Pastor and Gringo Pastor as separate local builds. Both English and Spanish official sheets agree on the selected macro values. Their portions are the named sandwiches; no six-inch or footlong size is inferred.

title: Panda Express: Mushroom Chicken and Orange Chicken portions
description: The official U.S. live nutrition table lists Mushroom Chicken at a 5.7 oz portion and The Original Orange Chicken at 6.2 oz. Each is one published entree portion; neither number is a bowl, plate or family tray.

title: Subway New Zealand: roast beef bread and dressing differ by format
description: The May 2026 New Zealand recipes give the roast beef sub and wrap different standard dressings. The sub lists processed cheddar, lettuce, spinach, tomato, onion and mayonnaise on roasted garlic bread. The wrap lists the same named vegetables and cheese with honey mustard on white flour wrap.

title: Quick France: match the drink volume to the menu entry
description: Quick France’s declaration valid from October 6, 2026 separates fountain drinks into 200 ml, 350 ml and 500 ml source portions. The French product names are preserved so that the local menu entry can be matched directly.

title: McDonald’s North & East India: Veg and Egg Mc Muffin
description: This comparison covers the Connaught Plaza Restaurants Private Limited menu in North & East India. It does not apply automatically to the West or South India franchise menus. That operating-region label belongs with the food entry whenever it is searched, compared or saved.

title: Burger King Singapore: Whopper and Whopper with Cheese
description: Burger King Singapore’s local menu publishes separate nutrition for WHOPPER and WHOPPER with Cheese. These are Singapore source recipes; a burger with the same brand name in another country is a separate record.

title: Debonairs South Africa: log the whole named pizza size
description: Debonairs Pizza South Africa’s local nutrition guide supplies separate whole named sizes. The selected Real Deal BBQ Chicken Small and Medium entries have the same published nutrition in its standard and halaal sections, so identical nutritional variants are merged with both source labels retained.

title: Burger King Canada: Whopper and Whopper with Cheese
description: The current Canadian nutrition explorer supplies two separate named standard servings: Whopper and Whopper with Cheese. Its Whopper is 710 kcal, 33 g protein, 50 g carbohydrate, 43 g fat and 1,150 mg sodium.

title: Burger King U.S.: use the local Whopper serving
description: The official U.S. nutrition explorer has its own published country payload. Its standard Whopper is 710 kcal, 34 g protein, 57 g carbohydrate, 42 g fat and 1,250 mg sodium.

title: Canada and U.S. Whoppers: same calories, different local records
description: Both current official country explorers list the standard Whopper at 710 kcal, but their remaining values differ. Canada lists 33 g protein, 50 g carbohydrate, 43 g fat and 1,150 mg sodium. The U.S. lists 34 g protein, 57 g carbohydrate, 42 g fat and 1,250 mg sodium. These are separate local records
